summary: Iteration 21 — Staff Performance Dashboard endpoint (GET /api/reports/staff-performance). Comprehensive pytest suite (23 tests) covering RBAC, response shape, aggregation correctness, preset variants, custom range, and zero-performers. All 23 tests PASSED against seeded Glow Up tenant data.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py:311 uses '$lt' with '.999999+00:00' upper bound — safe for normal usage but bills persisted with the exact microsecond suffix would be excluded. Not observed in seed data; leaving as informational.
reports.py:344 attributes revenue via it.get('total') or it.get('price'); this correctly maps to post-discount pre-tax line total set by compute_bill_totals, matching bills.py schema.
seed_data_creation: None — used pre-existing Glow Up seed bills/beauticians. No writes performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_staff_performance.py. Uses admin@glowup.com/admin123 (owner) and staff@glowup.com/staff123. Ground-truth aggregation test cross-checks /api/bills against /api/reports/staff-performance for the month. Seed expectation: preset=month → 11 rows, top_performer=Deepa Bhat.
verified_behaviours: Response shape: from/to/days/rows/totals/top_performer all present; trend length matches days list and preserves ordering
Aggregation: earnings == revenue + tips; avg_ticket == earnings/appointments (0 when appts=0); rows sorted by earnings desc
Top performer: matches first row with earnings > 0; null when all-zero (verified with future date range)
Cross-check against raw /api/bills for the month reproduces per-staff revenue/tips/services/appointments exactly
Presets: today (1 day), yesterday, week (7 days), month (from 1st to today), last_month (prev full calendar month)
Custom range with from_date/to_date works; invalid date → 400; swapped range gets normalised (not an error)
Zero-performers: every active beautician appears in rows even for date ranges with no bills
Seed sanity: preset=month returns exactly 11 rows and top_performer.beautician_name == 'Deepa Bhat'
